display.purpose: The landing h1 only. Two lines, balanced.

label.purpose: Field labels, notes, and every address, amount, hash and felt. Never below 12px.

motion.name: ease-thread
motion.purpose: The weave drawing itself and the hero lift: exponential ease-out from an already-visible default.

motion.name: duration-draw
motion.purpose: One stroke of the weave; strands are staggered 120ms.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one gold action on a view: sign, check, propose.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--gold, #c9a227); color: var(--ground, #101423); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 2px; transition: opacity 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #c9a227); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #8b93ad); border: 1px solid var(--strand, #5a67a0); cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 1; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Every other action: run, dry run, re-read, disconnect. Mono, hairline edge, gold on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: var(--cloth, #e6e2d8); font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; padding: 4px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--strand, #5a67a0); border-radius: 4px; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--gold, #c9a227); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #c9a227); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; border-color: var(--strand, #5a67a0); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Addresses, amounts and calldata. Mono, raised fill, strand edge, gold caret.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; } .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--muted, #8b93ad); } .ds-input { width: 100%; background: var(--raised, #171d31); color: var(--cloth, #e6e2d8); caret-color: var(--gold, #c9a227); font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; padding: 6px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--strand, #5a67a0); border-radius: 4px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--muted, #8b93ad) 70%, transparent); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #c9a227); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-input::selection { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--gold, #c9a227) 38%, transparent); }

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 20px; color: var(--cloth, #e6e2d8); } .ds-wordmark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-right: auto; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-nav-link { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--muted, #8b93ad); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--gold, #c9a227); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #c9a227); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
A weaver's workshop after dark. The ground is indigo — tarum dye, not a crypto template's navy — and across it run fixed vertical threads, faint, the warp the whole page is woven on. Content sits on that warp in thin strands of a lighter indigo; one thread of songket gold runs through the whole cloth and is spent only where value passes: the primary action, the privacy_invoke line in the hero, a hash that landed. Everything else is cloth-coloured text on the dark, set in a grotesque that reads as assembled rather than drawn, with an engineering mono for anything that is data.

The register is a craftsman's precision, not a product's shine. Surfaces are flat; depth is a hairline, never a shadow. The name means to weave separate strands into one, and the protocol constraint the product exists for — one invoke per transaction — has the same shape, so the mark, the hero diagram and the vocabulary all draw the same figure: strands entering apart and leaving as one. The one confirmed rejection: nothing that reads as a category default — no kicker over a heading, no card inside a card, no gradient text, no glass.
keyCharacteristics: Indigo ground with a fixed vertical warp; content woven across it in hairlines
One gold thread, spent only on value and action
Flat surfaces, hairline rules for structure, no shadows anywhere
Grotesque display, Plex Sans body, Plex Mono for every number, address and felt
Green for what is hidden, gold for what is visible, red-clay for what would fail
Only self-drawn SVG: the strand mark, the weave, the anonymity chart

rules.name: The One Thread Rule
rules.body: Gold appears on at most one control and a handful of data points per viewport. If two things on a screen are gold, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Meaning Rule
rules.body: Green, gold and red-clay carry meaning (hidden, visible, would fail) and are never used decoratively.

rules.name: The Data Is Mono Rule
rules.body: Anything read from the chain or the wallet — an address, an amount, a block, a felt, a verdict — is set in Plex Mono. Prose is never mono; mono is never a costume.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: Running text is capped at 60–62ch, which the design detector counts as ~76 characters. Data rows get the same cap; a 66-character hash fits in 62ch of mono.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: A bordered block never contains another bordered block. If a panel needs structure, it gets a rule above it.

rules.name: The Only Alert Rule
rules.body: One box is allowed on a page: an alert the reader has to find again (the ballot secret). Everything else that is a warning is red-clay text on the page's own surface.

dos: Do set every chain or wallet value in Plex Mono, at 12px or larger.
Do cap running text and data rows at 60–62ch.
Do separate sections and panels with a 1px Thread rule above them.
Do spend gold on one action per view and on landed value only.
Do keep the 2px gold :focus-visible outline on every control.
Do draw diagrams and marks as SVG in Strand, Gold and Ground.
donts: Don't put a bordered block inside a bordered block.
Don't add a shadow, a gradient, a glass effect or a pill.
Don't place a kicker or eyebrow above a heading.
Don't use grey for secondary text; tint it from the indigo (Muted Cloth).
Don't render a number the chain or the wallet did not give.
